title: Are WILD cockatoos smart enough to solve this puzzle?
summary: Maker's Muse designs a 3D-printed and laser-cut puzzle box to test whether wild sulphur-crested cockatoos can solve it. He documents how the birds work it out.
why: Recommended in cockatoo threads as a fun and remarkable demonstration of the birds' problem-solving ability.

quote.text: it's really remarkable to watch them figure it out
